name: toc
title: Table of Contents
description: Section navigation for documentation, guides, and long articles.

upstream.reason: Original document section navigation; no shadcn counterpart in the pinned catalogue.

motionProfile.reason: Native section navigation scrolls the page while one persistent indicator follows the active heading and the shell owns only its own block size.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: A later inserted navigation owns one opacity entrance on its own surface; the initial, already-visible navigation does not replay it.

layout.shared/selection.reason: One persistent indicator follows the active entry inside the track coordinate space; passive reading only selects its clamped endpoint box.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: The entry list owns its content-driven block height after a known entries or label revision; passive reading, indicator travel and document scroll never resize it.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Each link owns its own foreground clock and the indicator owns its own rail paint; an unprovable caller palette settles that owner immediately.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: The title label and every plain entry label keep one native text host; only changed graphemes are replaced.
